earnings.title: For Immediate Release
highlights: Net income was $357 million, translating to diluted earnings per share ("EPS") of $4.52
(Nasdaq: LPLA) (the "Company") today announced results for its third quarter ended September 30, 2026, reporting net income of $357 million, or $4.52 per share.
This compares with a net loss of $30 million, or $0.37 per share, in the third quarter of 2025 and net income of $379 million, or $4.74 per share, in the prior quarter.
Share repurchases were $301 million and dividends paid were $24 million

quotes.text: After an outstanding first half of the year, we delivered another quarter of strong business performance and excellent financial results, while making meaningful progress on key strategic initiatives.

The team delivered another quarter of outstanding results, highlighted by strong organic growth and record adjusted earnings per share, all while advancing our advisor experience and executing on our capital allocation strategy
